translations.1: Rain over the harbor town. A patrol car is parked in front of an old watch shop.
translations.10: Akira folded her own umbrella and wiped the drops from the floor.
translations.11: Akira, please leave your umbrella over here.
translations.12: Hikaru, who did you leave minding the Bureau?
translations.13: Nagi. She's only eighteen, but she's reliable. Don't worry, Akira.
translations.14: That helps. She handles the phones and the filing too.
translations.15: Chat later. Let's start the questioning first.
translations.16: Akira, may I hear from Mr. Takanashi first?
translations.17: In a trembling voice, the old man answered that he had closed the shop at nine last night.
translations.18: My grandfather has been polishing only that watch for years now.
translations.19: Yuki apparently hasn't slept since last night. His fingertips keep trembling.
translations.2: Boss, this is the scene. The door was still locked.
translations.20: Hikaru, what do you make of these footprints?
translations.21: Akira, these aren't the culprit's. The shoes are too big.
translations.22: Hikaru's eye is sharp. Still a rookie, but she's second to none.
translations.23: Kaoru took off his glasses and slowly pinched the corners of his eyes.
translations.24: That watch is also a keepsake from my mother.
translations.25: Nagi came running in, clutching a wet umbrella.
translations.26: Out of breath, she delivered the message from the phone.
translations.27: Akira, the forensics results are in. I'll share them with the boss right away.
translations.28: Go ahead. ...Hm. The culprit is inside the shop.
translations.3: Hm. Only a single pocket watch was stolen?
translations.30: Outside the window, the sound of the rain grew louder all at once.
translations.4: The shop owner, old Mr. Takanashi, sat in his chair, staring at the floor.
translations.5: So you're here, detectives. Let me say this first: touch nothing without permission.
